featured_reviews.name: Vijay Bankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely thankful to Adv. Sachin P. Kumar Sir and his team for their excellent support in my Income Tax assessment case. The department had proposed a huge addition of more than ₹3.65 crore in relation to the sale of my property, and I was very worried about the tax consequences.

Sachin Sir and his team patiently reviewed all my documents, prepared detailed replies, and represented my case before the Income Tax Department. They explained the entire process in simple language and guided me at every step.

Because of their hard work and expertise, the proposed addition of ₹3.65 crore was completely deleted during the assessment proceedings itself. This brought me immense relief. Only a small portion remains under appeal, which is also being handled by the team.

What impressed me the most was their attention to detail, prompt communication, and confidence in handling a complex matter. I am grateful for their efforts and the positive outcome they achieved in my case.

featured_reviews.name: abhijit gujrathi
featured_reviews.review_text:

Based on our experience, we introduced the firm to a reputed listed company for contract drafting, legal vetting, and advisory services. The company has been extremely satisfied with the quality of work delivered by *Adv. Sachin P. Kumar and his team*. Despite having an in-house legal department, they continue to seek his guidance on important contractual and legal matters.

Their ability to identify risks, provide commercially sound solutions, and deliver timely advice makes them a trusted legal partner. We highly recommend Sachin P. Kumar & Associates to any business looking for reliable and result-oriented legal counsel.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Goswami
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rahul Madhav Goswami – Review for the ITAT Proceedings for AY 2022 – 23
Highly satisfied with the professional handling of my tax litigation matter by Adv. Sachin P. Kumar Sir. Huge additions of Rs. 58,26,008/- were made vide the assessment order which was passed in my case and a demand of Rs. 58,32,907/- was raised by the Income Tax Department for the Assessment Year 2022–23. I had filed an appeal before the CIT (A) who did not adjudicate my matter on the basis of merits and had merely passed a non–speaking order thereby confirming the entire addition made by the Assessing Officer. Adv. Sachin Sir had preferred an appeal before the ITAT, Mumbai, and successfully got the matter remanded back to the file of Assessing Officer for fresh consideration. Adv. Sachin Sir’s expertise, dedication, and persistent advocacy has supported me in resolving complicated tax litigation matter effectively and I truly value his assistance and professionalism.

featured_reviews.name: Vinayak Jape
featured_reviews.review_text:
I sincerely thank Sachin Sir and his entire team for their excellent support. I was a Government employee and had received a notice from the department involving a huge addition. I was very worried and unable to sleep, as I was completely unaware of the situation and felt very fearful.
I found Sachin Sir through Google, and after meeting him, I felt much more relaxed and confident. With his expertise and guidance, not only was my entire demand reduced to zero, but he also gave me great mental peace during a very stressful time.
I am truly grateful for his help and highly recommend Sachin Sir and his team.

The grandfathering benefit continues, ensuring that genuine investments made in the past are not questioned under anti-avoidance regulations.
